name: 7ki PR review (no merge)
description: On pull request opened or pushed, review the diff, comment findings, and never merge or approve money-path changes.
instructions: Review the PR. Comment bugs, security issues, and missing tests. If the diff touches wallet, withdrawal, unified reward claim, cashController, or prisma/wallet.prisma, state that a human must review and merge — do not approve. Never merge, never push to main/master/v2, never use production secrets. Summarize in Slack #7ki-agents. Do not run Strix. Do not enable auto-merge.
